description.zh: 配置请求者付费的请求体。
description.en: The request body for configuring pay-by-requester.

descriptions.zh:
- 不允许匿名访问：如果您在Bucket上启用了请求者付费模式，则不允许匿名访问该Bucket。请求方必须提供身份验证信息，以便OSS能够识别请求方，从而对请求方而非Bucket拥有者收取请求所产生的费用。
当请求者是通过扮演阿里云RAM角色来请求数据时，该角色所属的账户将为此请求付费。

- 申请方需携带x-oss-request-payer信息：如果您在Bucket上启用了请求者付费模式，请求方必须在其请求中包含x-oss-request-payer:requester（在POST、GET和HEAD请求的Header信息中），以表明请求方已知悉请求和数据下载将产生费用。否则，请求方无法通过验证。
数据拥有者访问该Bucket时，可以不携带x-oss-request-payer请求头。数据拥有者作为请求者访问该Bucket时，请求产生的费用由数据拥有者（也是请求者）来支付。
descriptions.en:
- Anonymous access is not allowed: If you enable pay-by-requester for a bucket, anonymous access to the bucket is not allowed. The requester must provide identity verification information so that OSS can identify the requester and charge the requester instead of the bucket owner for the fees incurred by the request.
If the requester requests data by assuming a RAM role, the account to which the role belongs is charged for the request.

- The requester must include x-oss-request-payer: If you enable pay-by-requester for a bucket, the requester must include x-oss-request-payer:requester in the request header of POST, GET, and HEAD requests to acknowledge that the requester is aware of the fees incurred by the request and data download. Otherwise, the request fails to authenticate.
The data owner does not need to include the x-oss-request-payer header when accessing the bucket. When the data owner accesses the bucket as the requester, the data owner (who is also the requester) is charged for the fees incurred by the request.
